description: This file defines the PdfRubberStampAnnotation class, representing a rubber stamp annotation in a PDF document, including properties for icon display and associated keys.

classes.name: PdfRubberStampAnnotation
classes.description: Represents a rubber stamp annotation with customizable icon and appearance.

classes.name: PdfRubberStampAnnotation.Keys
classes.description: Contains predefined keys for the rubber stamp annotation dictionary, including the icon name.

methods.name: PdfRubberStampAnnotation
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new rubber stamp annotation.

methods.name: PdfRubberStampAnnotation(PdfDocument)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new rubber stamp annotation associated with a document.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets default subtype and color for the annotation.

methods.name: get Icon
methods.description: Gets the icon used for displaying the annotation, parsed from the Elements dictionary.

methods.name: set Icon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the annotation, updating the Elements dictionary.
